Before a model earns an audience, it is fitted. **Transformers** is where that fitting happens: a single, disciplined API through which hundreds of pretrained architectures are loaded, fine-tuned, and released.

It is the rare infrastructure project that behaves like a house — PyTorch, TensorFlow, and JAX are all welcome, and every model arrives with its own documentation, card, and provenance.

- Hundreds of pretrained models, one interface
- Trainer, pipelines, and inference built in
- The de facto wardrobe of the open-model ecosystem

> State-of-the-art is not a look. It is a fitting.
